message:
OK so the vulnerable version already has the `xmlStartTag` struct. The issue is that `pushTab` is only allocated in `nameNsPush` when `sax2` is true. But in `xmlParseElement`, the code accesses `ctxt->pushTab[ctxt->nameNr - 1].line` unconditionally.

Wait, but the summary says "bad-cast". Let me look at the `xmlStartTag` struct definition in the vulnerable code:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>grep -n "struct _xmlStartTag" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/parser.c</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
